entries.note: Independent whole-namespace audit of the merge union at worktree HEAD 290a76c8c (parents c44fdf1ea tui-scroll-keys side, ce57801168 origin/main side). Purely additive: every one of the 44 keys is byte-equal to its text in a parent (10 base in both, 26 in origin/main 4e32078b2, 8 transcript in 8704efd8e); no key changed, none new. source/context/target sha256 re-derived with shasum -a 256 from disk and match the draft. Checked: meaning vs en, terminology identical across the two halves and vs shipped catalogue usage (transcript, composer, sidebar, aside, fork, pin, asks, dock, todo, effort, subagent, session, row/cursor), glossary + style guide, label/help register, display-cell widths (rich cell_len, CJK double-width) vs declared maxCells (24 label / 72 help on the 8 transcript rows, all within), literal tokens (/new /resume /sidebar /effort esc), NFC, controls, spacing, punctuation, key order parity. Findings (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 1 MINOR, 3 NIT): MINOR F1 focus_sidebar.help and clear_transcript.help (A keys) use U+0020 before ';' where the fr guide requires U+202F in prose and the other 9 ';'/':' in the namespace use U+202F; fix is byte-swap, widths unchanged (75/70 cells). NIT caret/composer compressed ('la saisie garde le curseur'; 'saisie' is the catalogue composer term). NIT toggle_asks label 'Demandes en attente' vs help 'questions' (both attested: tui.notifications demandes, tui.asks question). NIT 8 A/base helps >72 cells and start_recording.label 25>24; the 24/72 maxCells are declared on the 8 transcript rows only.
